maria_se: Quick heads-up — on a call with HelixPrime + their SI. Private deployment stuck at network validation step, customer requires outbound-only NAT (no inbound) and the SI's helm chart assumes a public LB.

aditya_custeng: Can you paste the error they're seeing?

maria_se: SI reported the runtime pods never reach Ready; kube events show healthchecks failing because callback URL can't be reached. Customer insists callbacks must go via an egress proxy.

devon_pe: Ah — this is the chart using `service.type: LoadBalancer` for the callback webhook. We have a documented mode for "egress-only" customers but it's not the default.

maria_se: Exactly. SI wants an overnight patch so they can keep schedule. Is there an approved runbook we can hand them? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

kendall_sre: We do. It's in the private deploy playbook but I can paste the minimal changes for the SI to apply. They basically need to switch the webhook to use the control-plane proxy and set `CALLBACK_ADDRESS` to the egress proxy hostname. Minimal k8s overlay: 

```yaml
# overlay to avoid LoadBalancer creation
service:
  callback:
    type: ClusterIP
env:
  CALLBACK_ADDRESS: "egress-proxy.helix.svc.cluster.local:8443"
  CALLBACK_MODE: "egress-proxy"
```

kendall_sre: Also add this NetworkPolicy to allow egress to the proxy's namespace.

maria_se: Will forward to SI and Helix infra. Any concerns about TLS or certs when proxied?

kendall_sre: Make sure the proxy does TLS termination or pass-through based on their compliance needs. If the proxy terminates TLS we need mTLS between runtime and proxy — use our client cert bootstrap.

aditya_custeng: SI is worried about cert rotation. Is there an automated path?

devon_pe: Yes — use the `redwood-cert-bootstrap` sidecar. Example annotation: `redwood.com/cert-rotate: "true"`. That will fetch keys from the customer's KMS via the private control plane.

maria_se: Great. SI asked if we can escalate to an eng-oncall if we hit a kernel-level issue during their install window tonight.

kendall_sre: I'm available for oncall. If they hit OOM or GPU driver failures we'll need logs: `dmesg`, `kubectl describe pod`, and `journalctl -u nvidia-driver.service`.

si_onboard_bot: Reminder: private-deploy-runbook-v2.pdf updated 2026-02-10 by eng-infra. Link: https://internal.redwood/private-deploy-runbook-v2.pdf

aditya_custeng: Thanks, I'll stitch these notes into the SI ticket and send step-by-step with the overlays + annotations.

maria_se: One last ask from the SI — can we provide a quick diagram showing traffic flow when using egress proxy + control plane? They want it for their change approval board.

devon_pe: I'll draw a 1-page diagram and drop in the ticket.

maria_se: Awesome. Ping me when uploaded and I'll coordinate the HelixPrime CAB. :thumbsup:

aditya_custeng: Filing follow-up actions in the SI ticket: 1) apply overlay, 2) enable cert bootstrap, 3) validate egress connectivity, 4) SRE oncall standby. ETA tonight 23:00 UTC.

kendall_sre: I'll standby. If anything blocks, escalate to eng-runtime oncall and paste logs.

maria_se: Perfect. Thanks everyone — will update thread with CAB time.

si_onboard_bot: Ticket #SI-4981 updated: "HelixPrime egress proxy integration" assignees: aditya_custeng, devon_pe. Status: in-progress.
